name: Chocolate Nutty Granola with Banana & Greek Yogurt
instructions: Add oats to a large mixing bowl.
Roughly chop nuts and add to the bowl.
Melt coconut oil in a medium saucepan. Add maple syrup, salt, cocoa powder, and cinnamon; whisk to combine.
Pour oil mixture over oats and nuts and stir to coat.
Spread out on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 6-8 minutes, stirring halfway through cooking. Watch carefully as the nuts can burn easily.
Spoon yogurt into bowls and top with granola and bananas. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
